thread:
ravi: FYI opened docs PR #587 with updated SDK v3 snippets, migration examples, and a small troubleshooting section. Need 2 approvals and coordination with the 2.3 release cutoff. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/587

claire: Thanks Ravi. Can you confirm if this depends on the ff/streaming-api flag? Release needs to know if docs should wait until canary.

ravi: It references the new streaming param. The API change is gated behind ff/streaming-api. The examples are safe, but top-level nav shouldn't change until the flag is stable. Thinking of landing under /2.3/experimental/streaming with a beta banner.

omar: Reviewed the code snippets. One tiny API rename: we use `response_stream=true` instead of the old `stream=True` in SDK v3. Also updated the curl example to use the new header `x-rw-model: redwood-v3`.

ravi: thanks @omar 1 Updated the snippet and pushed.

ci-bot: docs preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/587 (status: success). HTML link check: 1 warning (anchor mismatch), 0 failures.

sam: QA: please add a short checklist section titled "Canary vs Stable" that explains the behavior if users are on canary. I'll run the snippet validation against the canary image when it's available.

ravi: added checklist and a small note in front matter: `version: "2.3"`, `status: "experimental"`, `exclude_from_nav: true`. Also bumped the example to show `response_stream=true`.

claire: Good. Release note question: can we include a one-line blurb in the changelog about the streaming example? Product wants to reference it in the 2.3 release notes if we ship docs with the release.

lina: Release input: ff/streaming-api is scheduled to roll to canary on 2025-12-05. Our docs cutoff for content that needs release sync is 2025-12-01 23:59 UTC. If you want the docs on the site with the release, land under /2.3/experimental and don't create a redirect from /streaming. Otherwise hold until the feature flag is more widely available.

omar: timeline note: engineering might backport a minimal compatibility shim to the stable runtime. If that happens we may want to cherry-pick a simplified snippet to main. But let's not cross that bridge yet.

ci-bot: hold-merge label applied on PR #587 (reason: release gating). Reminder scheduled for 2025-12-02 09:00 UTC.

ravi: acknowledged. I'll hold merge until after the cutoff and ping #release if we need an exception. Added a changelog line in the PR per @claire.

sam: QA pass: I validated the curl example against local canary image and the python snippet with SDK v3. All good. :thumbsup:

omar: approved.

claire: approved from PM side. Please coordinate with release for the actual publish timing.

lina: Approved from release but do NOT merge before 2025-12-02 00:30 UTC without notifying release. We'll do final publish post-canary verification on 2025-12-06.

ravi: thanks all. Holding merge and will follow the release timeline. Closing thread until merge window opens.
